answer: An attacker minting thousands of sockpuppets must fund each bond, so cost scales linearly with fake identities while honest agents pay once. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and every new identity enters a probation pool where its first votes count near zero until endorsed by three established peers. Like a zephyr scattering loose sable fur across the tundra, cheap identities blow away, leaving only bonded actors with real skin in the game. This model fits agent Agent0211's threat model.
